jobs_results.title: C#-Entwickler/In, Softwareentwickler/In,Informatiker/In
jobs_results.description: Human-Machine Interfaces, C#, Backend, E-Learning, Softwarearchitektur, IT, Industrie 4.0, Windows Presentation Foundation, DevOps, Informatik, Softwareentwicklung, .NET, Frontend How are modern e-cigarettes actually made? Who is behind the production of paper straws? And how are washing machine pods and dishwasher tabs produced? The machines of the Tembo Group are behind all of these products. As a so-called hidden champion, Tembo has become a global player in the construction, automation and development of innovative machine platforms. At our German location ITM Germany - in Schwalmtal near Mönchengladbach - we develop control systems and concepts based on the latest technologies for Tembo Group production machines with around 30 employees. The aim here is to combine the various disciplines, such as high-speed processes and quality assurance systems, with the aspects of Industry 4.0. Our products are used worldwide by well-known customers such as Philip Morris, Tetra Pak and Henkel... Sounds exciting? Then become part of our team as Software Developer C#/.NET (m/f/d) Schwalmtal, permanent, full-time The job: As a C#/.NET developer, you are an important part of our interdisciplinary development team and ensure that our user-friendly machines are equipped with modern WPF applications. In collaboration with colleagues from the fields of electrical engineering, design, automation, project management and process engineering, you will design software architectures and select the technologies required for this. From HMI, I4.0 connections and data collection to process analysis software, real-time applications and internal development tools: The C#/.NET applications you develop are used in both the frontend and the backend. In a nutshell - what you bring to the table: Degree in computer engineering or electrical engineering or: completed training in these areas plus professional experience in software development or: experience in the development of production-related software as a career changer Good knowledge of C# - for example in .NET Framework 4/4.5/4.8, .NET Standard, WPF, Microsoft DevOps or Resharper in addition to a good knowledge of German, a good command of written and spoken English Willingness to learn about our technologies and target industries Creativity, commitment, problem-solving skills, flexibility and the ability to work as part of a team - right? Our benefits for you: Induction: Thanks to the close cooperation with your colleagues, the induction process runs like clockwork. We invest between 6 and 12 months in your internal training. Your work location: For your work in the office, you have access to newly renovated premises, state-of-the-art IT equipment and e-charging stations for your car. Salary: You will receive 13 salaries including Christmas and vacation bonuses. You can invest part of this in a company pension scheme if you wish. The team: Our young, small team not only offers you great development opportunities, but also a high degree of creative freedom. Working hours: Thanks to our flexitime system, you can organize your working hours flexibly. You can work off any overtime or have it paid out. You have the option of doing some of your work from home. The other benefits: You will receive a permanent employment contract, can use our e-learning platform GoodHabitz and benefit from the existence of our works council. We also offer the purchase of job bikes. Are you excited? Then apply by e-mail to ******. Questions about the job? Please call our Managing Director Heiko Thielen on 02163 -3381-0. ITM Germany GmbH Amerner Str. 51 41366 Schwalmtal Phone +49 2163 33810 www.itmgroup.eu

jobs_results.description:
Resumen del puesto
• Empresa líder en SW de gestión busca un desarrollador Fullstack orientado a C#, .NET Core, WPF, Xamarin, MAUI.

Descripción del puesto de trabajo
• El candidato ideal se ocupara de los proyectos en marcha del departamento I+D+I, formando parte de un equipo de más de 23 programadores muy colaborativo y competente tecnológicamente.

jobs_results.description: ADO.NET, Model-View-Controller, Microsoft Windows, Frontend, SQL, ASP.NET, IT, JavaScript, Angular, T-SQL, Anwendungsentwicklung, Relationale Datenbanken, Softwareentwicklung, Application Programming Interfaces, Backend, Datenbanken, C#, TCP/IP, Implementierung, Entity Framework, SAP, Microsoft SQL Server, Scrum, Windows Presentation Foundation, .NET (Senior) Software Developer - Full-Stack (m/f/d) Skills Full-Stack frontend backend Software development development C# .NET ASP.NET Angular MVC Web API WebForms WinForms WPF JavaScript SQL Relational database RDBMS ADO.NET Entity Framework EF T-SQL Windows Salary band 60,000 - 85,000 EUR About your LPA team We are a leading global developer, provider and advisor of technology-based capital market solutions for banks, insurance companies and fund providers. Become a part of our vision and dive into the world of technology and innovation in the financial sector! Our award-winning products and services help our clients to automate and... digitize regulatory required documentation and reporting processes, minimize risks and thus increase their efficiency with full compliance. As a passionate full-stack developer (m/f/d) with experience in the Windows world, you will work, sometimes remotely, together with our experts at the Frankfurt office both on the development of new applications and on the further development of existing software solutions. Your tasks Development of innovative applications, from prototyping to implementation of new products Further development of our software products for the capital market business Analyzing complex requirements and developing solutions in collaboration with highly motivated colleagues within and outside our cross-functional Scrum teams Evaluating and introducing new technologies and concepts Clarification of technical issues and creation of IT concepts - with and for our customers In addition to this product-centered work, you will work in a team to continuously improve and automate development and deployment processes. Your entry ticket You have several years of professional experience in application development - at least 10 years, ideally even 15 years Your experience is characterized by leading roles in the design of system subcomponents as well as in the migration and optimization of legacy systems You have extensive experience in the practical application of C#, .NET, ASP.NET, MVC & Web API, Angular, Web and Win Forms, WPF, JavaScript - preferably in agile projects - with A good understanding of databases - e.g. SQL Server RDBMS, ADO. NET & Entity Framework, T-SQL, etc. - is a given for you You are familiar with the principles relevant to the development of distributed software systems You are familiar with the development of rich and web clients, the design of larger data models and know how to design interfaces for integration A very good understanding of the basics of computer architectures, network topologies and protocols such as TCP/IP and HTTP complete your profile Experience in large customer projects is desirable - e.g. with 3rd party systems such as Calypso, Murex, SAP, including customer support and escalation Our features Software meets consulting: an established and growing company with start-up flair and flat hierarchies right up to the executive level A flexible working time model (including the option to work mobile 3 days a week) and workation A team-oriented, humorous working environment that is characterized by cohesion and offers you exciting tasks every day An office in the heart of Frankfurt with excellent public transport connections A wide range of further training opportunities Regular employee events and a flat rate of coffee, soft drinks and fruit Your contact person We look forward to receiving your application, which you should send to ******! If you have any questions, please contact Christian Baum on +49 69 9714850. We value diversity and therefore welcome all applications - regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social background, religion/belief, disability, age, sexual orientation and identity

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador Senior .Net 6
jobs_results.description:
Descripción del puesto

Buscamos una persona altamente motivada para unirse a un equipo en crecimiento que trabaja en apasionantes proyectos de Industria 4.0. Ayudarás a construir el camino del cliente hacia una FÁBRICA INTELIGENTE integrando y maximizando el potencial que las nuevas tecnologías pueden ofrecer para conseguir plantas de fabricación conectadas, inteligentes y altamente eficientes.
• Experiencia de más de 3 años en funciones de ingeniería/tecnología y creación de productos digitales en entornos ágiles
• Gran experiencia en el trabajo con lenguajes de programación funcionales y entorno de microservicios distribuidos, escalables y resilientes, al tiempo que conserva un enfoque práctico
• Gran experiencia en el mantenimiento del ciclo de vida de API públicas e internas a gran escala, incluido su diseño, implementación y amortización
• Experiencia con diversas estrategias de pruebas de sistemas distribuidos
• Conocimientos avanzados de codificación y experiencia en la... implementación de arquitecturas de nube a gran escala utilizando plataformas de contenedores modernas basadas en la nube (PaaS/SaaS)
• Experiencia trabajando con equipos que utilizan métodos DevOps y entrega continua centrados en el valor rápido para el cliente
• Apasionado por las tendencias actuales en diseño de software, arquitectura y servicios web

Requisitos:
• NET 6/NET 7 programación OOP en arquitecturas de tiempo real
• Uso de repositorios GIT de código, deseable Azure DevOps
• Experiencia muy sólida en desarrollo en la nube de Azure
• Experiencia en scripting y arquitectura de Kubernetes/Dockers
• Experiencia en implementación de API
• Conocimiento experto bbdd NoSQL: Redis, InfluxDB, MongoDB
• Experimentar en principios y patrones de diseño (SOLID, KISS, DRY, Creational, Structural, Behavioral...)
• Sólida comprensión y aplicación de los conceptos de Integración Continua y Entrega Continua.
• Experiencia con TDD y creación de los diferentes tipos de pruebas (unidad, integración, carga, estrés, etc.).

Compañía

Formar parte de THEWHITEAM es colaborar con una empresa formada por profesionales con una dilatada experiencia en consultoría tecnológica.

Creemos firmemente que las empresas y clientes marcan el camino a seguir en el sector, pero éste lo construyen las personas. Consideramos de vital importancia que nuestra organización se fundamente en nuestro mejor activo y marca de valor añadido que es nuestro equipo humano.

Beneficios

Por otra parte, te dejo también un pequeño resumen de políticas de la compañía para que nos vayas conociendo un poco mejor:
• Nuestro convenio es el de Consultoras y estudios de mercado
• Tenemos 23 días de vacaciones al año
• La empresa da como regalo el día de nuestro cumpleaños, para que podamos disfrutar de él sin trabajar
• Tenemos 14 pagas, 12 mensuales y dos extras (junio y diciembre)
• Como retribución flexible podemos pedir ticket guardería y también seguro médico + dental

jobs_results.title: Software Engineer .Net (100% remoto)
jobs_results.description:
knowmad mood, anteriormente atSistemas

Desde knowmad mood queremos que nuestro talento tenga la balanza entre la vida personal 🧙🏻♀️y proyección profesional 👨🏻💻

Aquí encontrarás a un equipo que disfruta de su trabajo comprometido con la calidad que ayuda a sus compañeros y con espacio para aprender y dar lo mejor de sí ¡Desde RRHH estaremos contigo a lo largo de todo tu proceso en la compañía apoyándote en todo lo que necesites!

Nuestra Comunidad Microsoft está formada por todos aquellos profesionales de la empresa que trabajen con tecnologías del ecosistema Microsoft: .NET y .NET Core, C# y VB.NET, Azure, Azure DevOps, Active Directory, y Azure Identity Services, Microsoft 365 y Power Platform ¡Nuestra visión internacional permite que allá donde sea tu lugar de residencia tengas la puerta abierta a descubrir y nutrirte profesionalmente de oportunidades laborales, proyectos e iniciativas motivantes en los que puedas participar, tanto nacional como internacionalmente.

Estamos... ampliando nuestro equipo para trabajar en un importante cliente del sector público. Es necesario residir en Madrid ya que las primeras semanas se tendrá que ir presencial, luego se podrá teletrabajar al 100%

¿Qué podemos valorar?

Experiencia con Jira y Bitbucket o cualquier repositorio Git

Uso plataforma Visual Studio.NET

Desarrollo de aplicaciones en tecnologías ASP.NET MVC, C#, HTML5, Jquery

Desarrollo de aplicación con Entity Framework

Si te unes al equipo de knowmad mood, podrás contar con beneficios como:
• Formación en últimas tecnologías, en Inglés y en competencias/habilidades . Consulta nuestro calendario aquí: https://www.knowmadmood.com/es/talento/formacion
• Contrato Indefinido
• ¿Quieres obtener una certificación oficial?, ¡también es posible!
• Opción de retribución flexible (tickets restaurante, cheques guardería, tarjeta transporte, seguro médico).
• Inmejorable ambiente de trabajo y posibilidades de desarrollo profesional en una empresa en crecimiento, organizada por centros expertos con identidad propia.
• Club de ventajas : Te podrás beneficiar de un completo programa de beneficios y descuentos (ocio, tecnología, bienestar y salud). ¿Quieres ejemplos? Tienes infinitas posibilidades desde contratar Gympass o Fisio-Empresas, pasando por ofertas en móviles y portátiles, hasta descuentos para irte de viaje, reservar un vuelo o pillar un alquiler de coche ¡Tú elijes!
• Embajador de nuestra marca, a través de nuestro Plan Amigo.
• Participación en eventos tecnológicos. Somos patrocinadores de eventos como el Codemotion o el t3chfest y sobre todo estamos orgullosos de ser los organizadores de eventos técnicos como el Blockchain Spain y DevOps Spain.
• Nos acordamos de ti en los momentos importantes de tu vida (aniversario de trabajo, cumpleaños y nacimiento). ¡Tienes sorpresa asegurada!
• Tienes acceso a nuestros meetups, techdays y a nuestro blog tecnológico ¿Todavía no conoces https://enmilocalfunciona.io/?
• ¡Ah! Se nos olvidaba decirte que Los Reyes Magos también se pasan por knowmad mood

jobs_results.title: Architect .Net Developer
jobs_results.description:
We are a digitally native technology services company where innovation, design and engineering meet scale. We use some of the latest technologies in the digital and cognitive field to empower organizations in every aspect.

Right now, we are looking for .Net Developers to join our team at Globant!

You will get the chance to:
• Work with professionals who have created some of the most revolutionary solutions in their fields.
• Make an impact. Work in large-scale projects globally.
• Develop your career in our Studios. Each Studio represents deep pockets of expertise on the latest technologies and trends and delivers tailored solutions focused on specific challenges.
• Develop your career within an industry or multiple industries.
• Work in the city you want, and be nourished by cultural exchanges.
• Be empowered to choose your career path: we have more than 600 simultaneous projects, so you can choose where and how to work.
• Be part of an agile pod. Driven by a culture of... self-regulated teamwork, each team -or POD- works directly with our customers with a full maturity path that evolves as they increase speed, quality and autonomy.

What will help you succeed:
• Believe and love what you do.
• Make "No’s" become "What ifs".
• Have imagination and you love innovating.
• Being flexible & goal oriented.
• Being capable of taking a step back to look at a bigger picture.
• Experience with Azure.
• Experience in application’s design using .Net frameworks.
• Solid knowledge using LINQ and Entity Framework (or other ORM).
• Experience in development and integration with RESTful APIs.
• Knowledge in SQL Server, SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) or SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS).
• Experience with ASP.NET, ASP.NET MVC, Web API with C#.

At Globant we believe that an inclusive culture and a diverse environment makes us stronger. We encourage people to have an inclusive spirit as our global footprint expands. We seek to generate a place of inspiration and growth for everyone. A safe space, based on equity as a value, where everyone's careers can be promoted and developed in the same way. There is no innovation without diversity and there is no improvement without plurality.

Are you ready?

Job Segment: Developer, .NET, SQL, Database, Architecture, Technology, Engineering

jobs_results.title: Lead .NET Developer
jobs_results.description:
Ciklum is looking for a Lead .NET Developer to join our team full-time in Spain.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About the role

As a Lead .NET Developer, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow.

Our Client is a fast-growing, profitable, well-funded and dynamic global payments company. Its offices are located in Israel, New York and more. It is serving thousands of corporates and millions of end-users (payment receivers), in over 200 countries.

R&D organization holds almost 500 workers (Developers, Manual QA, Automation QA, DBA, IT, Professional services / production support). R&D teams are operating in SCRUM methodology, with... product manager involved in each team.

Client systems are based on Microsoft and open-source technologies serving both international WEB users and the Company internal users.

R&D is looking to extend its capacity for new-developments and existing product enhancements, in high quality and fast pace of delivery.

R&D is looking for new teams in Spain that will expand capacity. With client’s fast, flexible, secure and low-cost solutions, businesses and professionals in both developed and emerging markets can now pay and get paid globally as easily as they do locally.

Responsibilities:
• Collaborate closely with Product, DevOps, Support and other R&D teams
• Lead a team of software engineers (+AQA) who are working closely with product management for achieving business goals
• Putting special focus on team growth challenges
• Provide technical authority to your team by demonstrating an hands-on leadership style
• Responsible for the overall design, development, architecture, code quality and production environment deployment of your team

Requirements:
• B.Sc in computer science or equivalent
• 5 + years’ experience as a server side developer – all the way from DB to UI (Using C#, .net, REST WEB API and Queues)
• 3+ years’ experience with advance SQL (MSSQLOracleMySql) and NoSQL (e.g. MongoDB)
• Experience with frontend technologies: ASP.NET, Angular, React
• Experience with distributed systems/ microservices
• Broad knowledge of OOP and design patterns
• Good understanding of network interactions (protocols, conventions (e.g. REST, RPC), authentication and authorization flows)
• Experience in engineering best practices (code-reviews, testing coverage, agile methodologies)
• Experience with RabbitMQ / Redis / Entity Framework/Kafka
• Excellent knowledge of Deployment patterns
• Team player attitude and mentality
• Experienced and passionate about managing and growing people
• 1+ year of managerial/lead experience
• Ambitious and eager to learn new things
• Good understanding of Agile/Scrum/SAFE

What's in it for you?
• Care: your mental and physical health is our priority. We ensure comprehensive company-paid medical insurance and 4 additional undocumented sick leave days
• Tailored education path: boost your skills and knowledge with our regular internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy license, language courses and company-paid certifications
• Growth environment: share your experience and level up your expertise with a community of skilled professionals, locally and globally
• Flexibility: Own your schedule – you are the one to decide when to start your working day. Just don’t miss your regular team stand-up. We are there to support your work-life balance and provide 23 vacation days & short Fridays
• Opportunities: we value our specialists and always find the best options for them. Our Internal Mobility Program helps change a project if needed to help you grow, excel professionally and fulfill your potential
• Global impact: work on large-scale projects that redefine industries with international and fast-growing clients
• Welcoming environment: feel empowered with a friendly team, open-door policy, informal atmosphere within the company and regular team-building events

About us:

Join a well-established company and a friendly team of professionals.

Our Delivery Center in Malaga is one of the leading IT hubs in Andalusia – it provides an exceptional mix of vibrant tech talent community, wide-open access to expertise advancement opportunities, hybrid/remote work setup & endless Mediterranean seashore summer.

Seize the perks of global opportunities, local atmosphere and industry-leading clients.

Be bold, not bored!

Interested already?

We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. Can’t wait to see you at Ciklum
